Mansoor bin Mohammed: Today, I chaired a meeting of the Higher Committee for the Protection of the Rights of People of Determination to review government efforts to empower them, enhance inclusive services and improve their quality of life, in line with the Dubai Social Agenda 33. This year, more than 3,500 People of Determination have benefited from over AED 100 million in financial support, while residential plots have been allocated to 121 Emirati People of Determination. Dubai remains committed to supporting People of Determination and their families, ensuring they have the opportunities and support to realise their potential and participate fully in society.
